types.name: claims.v1.ClaimCampaign
types.doc: ClaimCampaign identifies the campaign associated with a reward or claim.

fields.name: campaign_id
fields.doc: Stable campaign identifier.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Campaign name. Existing claims retain the name that applied when they were created.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: Campaign description. Existing claims retain the description that applied when they were created.

fields.name: claim_policy
fields.doc: How frequently each root account may claim from this campaign.

types.name: claims.v1.ClaimDailyRewardRequest
types.doc: ClaimDailyRewardRequest claims today's reward for the authenticated root account.

types.name: claims.v1.ClaimDailyRewardResponse
types.doc: ClaimDailyRewardResponse contains the result of claiming today's reward.

fields.name: claim_id
fields.doc: Claim identifier.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: Current claim state.

fields.name: claimed_at
fields.doc: Time when the claim completed. Omitted while the claim is processing.

fields.name: rewards
fields.doc: Assets and amounts granted by this claim. They do not change after the claim is created.

fields.name: transfers
fields.doc: Transfers created for each reward asset. Empty while the claim is processing.

fields.name: reset_at
fields.doc: Start of the next UTC calendar day.

fields.name: campaign
fields.doc: Campaign associated with this claim, using the name and description that applied when the claim was created.

types.name: claims.v1.ClaimPolicy
types.doc: ClaimPolicy controls how often a recipient may claim from a campaign.

values.name: UTC_DAILY
values.doc: One claim is available to each root account per UTC calendar day.

types.name: claims.v1.DailyClaimReward
types.doc: DailyClaimReward describes one asset and amount offered or granted by a claim.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc: Asset identifier.

fields.name: asset_code
fields.doc: Asset code.

fields.name: amount_e18
fields.doc: Claim amount in 18-decimal unified asset units.

values.name: CLAIM_AVAILABLE
values.doc: Today's reward is available to claim.

values.name: CLAIM_PROCESSING
values.doc: Today's claim is being processed. Retrying returns the same claim.

values.name: CLAIM_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: No reward is active for the current UTC day.

types.name: claims.v1.DailyClaimTransfer
types.doc: DailyClaimTransfer identifies the transfer created for one claimed asset.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc: Asset identifier.

fields.name: transfer_id
fields.doc: Transfer identifier.

types.name: claims.v1.ErrorCode
types.doc:
ErrorCode identifies stable, machine-readable Claims API errors.
 Values mirror the REST problem+json code field after removing ERROR_CODE_.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_CLAIM_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: The claim reward is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_UNAUTHENTICATED
values.doc: A valid session is required. API keys cannot access claims.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
values.doc: The applicable request rate limit was exceeded.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_CLAIM_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: No reward is available for the current UTC day.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_CONFLICT
values.doc: The request encountered concurrent claim activity. Retry the request.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_REQUEST_TOO_LARGE
values.doc: The REST request body exceeds the 1 KiB limit.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: The service is temporarily unable to complete the request.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_INTERNAL_ERROR
values.doc: The request failed because of an unexpected server error.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_PERMISSION_DENIED
values.doc: The claim request was not permitted.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_FAILED_PRECONDITION
values.doc: A required condition for completing the claim was not satisfied.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_SOCIAL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED
values.doc: Verify an X or Discord account before claiming a reward.

types.name: claims.v1.ErrorDetail
types.doc:
ErrorDetail is attached to ConnectRPC errors for structured error handling.
 Application errors use these codes, with REST spelling defined above.
 Cancellation and deadline errors use their transport codes without this detail.
 Protocol decoding, routing, readiness, and network failures may occur before
 application error handling and are not guaranteed to include this detail.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable error code matching the REST problem+json code field.

types.name: claims.v1.GetDailyClaimStatusRequest
types.doc: GetDailyClaimStatusRequest retrieves today's reward and claim status for the authenticated root account.

types.name: claims.v1.GetDailyClaimStatusResponse
types.doc: GetDailyClaimStatusResponse contains the reward and claim status for the current UTC day.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: Current state of today's claim.

fields.name: reset_at
fields.doc: Start of the next UTC calendar day.

fields.name: rewards
fields.doc: Assets and amounts available or already granted for the current UTC day. Future rewards are not returned.

fields.name: claim_id
fields.doc: Claim identifier. Empty until a claim has been created.

fields.name: campaign
fields.doc: Campaign associated with the current reward or existing claim. Omitted when no campaign applies.
